style: Original polished vector interpretation of the existing terminal soda-can mascot.
typography: Lettering outlined from locally licensed Avenir Next; utility labels outlined from Menlo. No font files are included.

guidance.oauth: Use sodapop-oauth.png and badge background #09090B. Keep the supplied breathing room for circular crops.
guidance.repository: Use sodapop-repo-social.png for the repository social preview. Use sodapop-banner.svg or .png for a README.
guidance.landing: Use the transparent mascot and the matching light/dark lockup. Use sodapop-og.png as the social-sharing card.
guidance.editing: The SVGs are self-contained vector masters with outlined text: no scripts, linked images, or external fonts.
guidance.affiliation: Sodapop is independent. These assets do not contain GitHub, Copilot, or Charm logos.
